sources.title: User-supplied Discord announcement: Pre-Halloween Flash Sales — 6 Rounds, 36 Products
sources.note: Supplied verbatim by the maintainer in this task; not independently retrieved from Discord. No announcement permalink was supplied, so this URL is its linked poster post. Discord is the source of truth for rounds 1–3 names, order, quantities and contents, the no-gifting rule, and Unix timestamps: R1 1790814600–1790987340; R2 1790987400–1791246540; R3 1791246600–1791419340; overall end 1792021800. It adds Halloween Power Basket ×1 to each Blue Halloween Vampire set and ×5 to Grim Reaper Fashion Set, omitted by the poster. Rounds 4–6 details come from poster 3.

sources.title: Flash Sale gift-function notice linked by Discord
sources.note: The supplied announcement explicitly states that the Gift function is not available and purchases must be made on the account that will use the item. This is the notice link from that text; the linked notice was not independently retrieved.

sources.title: Haunted Harvest poster 2: flash-sale introduction and rounds 1–3
sources.note: Original 940×3003 image, visually checked at native resolution in three crops. Flash-sale introduction begins near y=470 and round panels occupy y≈740–3003. Counts 7/8/6. All prices, quantities and STOCK badges verified. Source order is rows top to bottom, left then right, matching supplied Discord. Discord adds the omitted Halloween baskets. STOCK quantities are transcribed as advertised, not live remaining inventory; purchase-limit scope is not stated. Numeric schedules agree with Discord timestamps.

sources.title: Haunted Harvest poster 3: rounds 4–6 and policies
sources.note: Original 940×2303 image, visually checked at native resolution in three crops. Counts 5/5/5. All offer names, components, quantities, LTC prices, STOCK badges and EDT dates verified; source order is rows top to bottom, left then right. Singular unmultiplied components count as one. Seres package heading is truncated, but its three components match the previously verified named package. Title of Tome of the Ancients explicitly specifies [Account]. STOCK does not state purchase-limit scope. Final end agrees with Discord.
